system: Skill-registry gate: validate third-party skills before absorbing (open-source only, static analysis, pre-publish scan), pin integrity (lockfile + content hash), expose catalog progressively (search, then read, then fetch files), audit every install. Never absorb unscanned skills; never dump the whole catalog into context.
anti_patterns: absorver skill sem scan (13%+ dos marketplaces têm críticas)
jogar catálogo inteiro no contexto (usar disclosure progressiva)
instalar sem lockfile/hash (sem pin de integridade)
binários em skills (100% open source exigido)
